alt: Timeline of a sample library: the Memories strip, then photos grouped by day, newest first, with the place of each day
A photo open in the lightbox with its Info panel: caption, people, date, file, the place on a map, tags, rights and the albums it is in
People page: the face of each named person, the number of people and a link to the faces to review, with sort and group menus
Places page: a world map with clusters of photos, above a grid of countries with the number of photos in each
Events page: albums made from days out, each named after the day, the time of day and the place, with its date and number of photos
Timeline with the Filter popover open: media type, the screenshots and documents to hide, show only favorites, and a note that this is the default view
Photo details in the lightbox with the category badge under the file name, which says whether the photo is a photo, a screenshot or a document
Albums page: your own albums, the people, and collections of things, tags, places, events and folders
Files dragged over the timeline: a dashed outline around the window and a card that says Drop photos and videos to upload
Admin area with the Site settings: switches for user registration, uploads, the Nextcloud integration, a folder for each new user and release checks
